name: Fresh Canna | 1.2g Live Resin Infused Preroll | Northern Lights
description:
Built for full-body impact, this 1.2G infused pre-roll combines premium indica flower with terpene-rich live resin for amplified potency and smooth, heavy smoke. Designed for evening use and high-tolerance consumers seeking deep relaxation.

Strain: Northern Lights (Indica)

Infusion: Full-spectrum Live Resin

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sweet pine, earthy spice, subtle herbal musk

Flavor: Smooth woody earth with light sweetness and resinous finish

Effects: Deep body melt, tranquil mental calm, sedating night-time finish

Experience: Thick smoke output, slow even burn, intensified terpene profile
